summary: Recent updates in the Media IPC (Inter-Process Communication) area of the Firefox browser focus on improving performance and reliability. By applying **std::move** in various modules, Firefox can now handle data more efficiently, reducing unnecessary copying and making processes smoother, especially during video playback and other media activities. Additionally, adjustments to WebGPU—specifically in error handling for readback buffers—help ensure that graphics and media rendering operate correctly, which is essential for a better user experience with high-quality visuals. These improvements are part of ongoing efforts to enhance the overall responsiveness and stability of media-related features within the browser.
